main_text.p: menta Papilionum, ingenti multitudine volantium, pro fanguine plurima accipientis. Interim vermes innumeros in fanguine humano inveniri, obser-vatum à Kirchero in illuftri Arte Lucis & umbra, (notante idem Bartholin. cent. 4. hiftor. 72.) itemque in Scrutinio Peftis. De Ventorum materia atque effentia eleganter differit Illuftriffi. D. Comes, dicitque p. 34. Ventum effe fluvium ingen-tem fimilium atomorum, feu, pag. 48. ventum revera nihil aliud effe, quam iftiuf-modi atomi impetu quodam huc illuc agita-ti. Atomos autem illas, quae ventum conftituant, videtur imprimis cenfe-re exhalationes terreftres: namque p. 39. hæc corpufcula, inquit, qua ventum ex monte Vifo (de quo ibidem agit,) vementem caufant excitantque, denfa & terreftria funt, etenim nix, inquit, (quæ perpetuo mons ille obtegitur,) cum partibus aquofis atque terreftribus à frigore invicem unitis confiet, radiorum folarium calore eadem feparante vifcofa partes unà cum

page.notes: Marginal notes in the left margin are partly cut off and only partly legible; the printed marginal references were transcribed as far as legible and otherwise omitted. Several words in the margin are damaged. Uncertain readings in the main text: "Scrutinio" and "Ventorum" may be affected by the scan.
